description: This file defines the OLERead class used for reading OLE compound document files, including parsing and extracting streams and directory structures.

classes.name: OLERead
classes.description: Class for reading and parsing OLE compound document files, primarily used for extracting embedded streams, directories, and metadata.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and initializes internal structures from the specified OLE file, validating its format and parsing directory entries.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Extracts a data stream from the OLE file given its stream index, returning the binary content.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads a standard stream or chain of sectors starting from a given sector ID.

methods.name: readPropertySets
methods.description: Parses the directory entries in the OLE file, extracting names, types, start blocks, and sizes of streams.

methods.name: getInt4d
methods.description: Static helper function to read a 4-byte integer from a data string at a given position.
